scope: Native artifact engine; no release artifact inspected; observations are development-source only

machines.name: Operation admission, lock ownership and store availability
machines.explicitness: implicit control state over files and guards
machines.state_storage: native file handles; Windows store.lock; Linux root descriptor; Darwin lock file

transitions.guard: valid protocol/request
transitions.effects: Return process capabilities/schema without opening repository.
transitions.failure_retry: Invalid request or unknown operation rejects before repository effects.

transitions.guard: supported platform, safe real root
transitions.effects: Open root-anchored filesystem and operation-local memo.
transitions.failure_retry: Unsupported platform/unsafe root refuse.

transitions.guard: operation in sharedObservation, or read mode exact
transitions.effects: Acquire shared lock for selected read operations. Windows observation requires existing store metadata; Linux needs none. Darwin lock path may create store.lock.
transitions.failure_retry: Busy: bounded 2s retry then LOCK_TIMEOUT; fresh read advised. Missing Windows metadata: NO_LOCAL_STORE.

transitions.guard: not shared observation
transitions.effects: Acquire exclusive lock; index remains exclusive despite being observational. Windows index uses read-access ObservationLock.
transitions.failure_retry: LOCK_FAILED / LOCK_TIMEOUT; no semantic mutation.

transitions.guard: writer lock possible
transitions.effects: Initialize platform lock metadata only; report created or present. Linux reports present.
transitions.failure_retry: Native filesystem failures remain explicit.

transitions.guard: operation is not recovery or successful replay
transitions.effects: Refuse normal canonical reads and writes until deliberate recovery.
transitions.failure_retry: RECOVERY_REQUIRED; use existing transaction ID, not blind new mutation ID.

transitions.guard: deferred cleanup
transitions.effects: Unlock and close filesystem; discard per-operation memo.
transitions.failure_retry: No daemon or persistent in-memory coordinator.

machines.name: Journaled transaction and operation identity
machines.explicitness: explicit persisted journal states plus implicit staging and acknowledgement states
machines.state_storage: transactions/<operation_id>.json; stage files; history before-images; stored result

transitions.guard: valid id/hash, <=512 safe disjoint edits, exact before bytes, no pending journal
transitions.effects: Write synced before-images and destination stages; create directories as needed; retain request hash and result.
transitions.failure_retry: Prepublication errors clean temporary stages/backups when safe; no target changes.

transitions.guard: create-only journal publication
transitions.effects: Durably publish full write intent before touching canonical targets.
transitions.failure_retry: Publication uncertainty returns COMMIT_OUTCOME_UNKNOWN and preserves recovery material.

transitions.guard: current target still equals its before hash
transitions.effects: Replace/create/delete targets sequentially; may expose partial files only behind recovery block.
transitions.failure_retry: Any failure after publication returns COMMIT_OUTCOME_UNKNOWN; do not assume no change.

transitions.guard: all replacements successful
transitions.effects: Persist committed journal including original result and before-image references.
transitions.failure_retry: Final acknowledgement write failure is outcome unknown; inspect/replay same operation ID.

transitions.guard: same request hash
transitions.effects: Return stored original outcome with replay=true; no new revision, no repeated effect.
transitions.failure_retry: Old journals without result require refresh_required, not fabricated latest identity.

transitions.guard: hash differs
transitions.effects: Refuse operation-id reuse.
transitions.failure_retry: OPERATION_ID_REUSE; new logical intent needs new ID.

transitions.guard: journal pending
transitions.effects: Refuse ordinary replay pending recovery.
transitions.failure_retry: RECOVERY_REQUIRED.

transitions.guard: terminal rollback
transitions.effects: Refuse resurrecting rolled-back write.
transitions.failure_retry: OPERATION_ROLLED_BACK; inspect then explicitly choose new operation.

machines.name: Recovery and recovery conflicts
machines.explicitness: explicit terminal states; inferred conflict and partial target position
machines.state_storage: journal plus current target/stage/backup digests

transitions.guard: all targets currently before or after; every necessary stage verified before any write
transitions.effects: Complete missing edits, clean verified unused stages, persist terminal state.
transitions.failure_retry: RECOVERY_CONFLICT for third-party edits; COMMIT_OUTCOME_UNKNOWN for I/O interruption; retry same recovery.

transitions.guard: all current targets before or after; backups hash-valid before any write
transitions.effects: Restore old bytes/delete new targets, clean stages, preserve transaction/history.
transitions.failure_retry: All-target preflight prevents overwriting outside changes; incomplete recovery stays prepared.

transitions.guard: valid terminal journal
transitions.effects: Return replay without reapplying inverse/forward edits.
transitions.failure_retry: Recovery is not general undo of a committed arbitrary write.

transitions.event: target has third digest / missing recovery material
transitions.guard: preflight mismatch
transitions.effects: No preflight mutation; preserve evidence for manual reconciliation.
transitions.failure_retry: RECOVERY_CONFLICT; must resolve actual bytes before retry.

transitions.guard: invalid shape/name/path/hash, unreadable, listed file disappears
transitions.effects: Refuse to treat store as clean.
transitions.failure_retry: CORRUPT_JOURNAL / RECOVERY_REQUIRED / I/O diagnostic.

machines.name: Artifact representation, version and canonical identity
machines.explicitness: implicit control state over files and guards
machines.state_storage: HTML embedded model, schema_version, normative/model hashes and catalog

transitions.guard: closed supported kind and schema, unique identity/path
transitions.effects: Create revision 1, typed normative state, presentation, checksums; plan tasks PENDING, governance draft.
transitions.failure_retry: Duplicate identity, existing canonical slug or catalog bounds refuse.

transitions.guard: historical schema supported and no newer fields mislabeled
transitions.effects: Validate and expose without automatic upgrade or recertification.
transitions.failure_retry: Unsupported versions/assistive fields under old labels fail closed.

transitions.guard: new fields required
transitions.effects: Write appropriate 0.3.2/0.3.3 schema while retaining history.
transitions.failure_retry: No silent reinterpretation on read.

transitions.guard: unique ID; correct directory/kind; no same-slug HTML+Markdown
transitions.to: valid catalog or invalid or ambiguous
transitions.effects: Spec and plan directories remain strict on catalog scans; optional kinds read only when active.
transitions.failure_retry: One invalid strict spec/plan can reject unrelated catalog-based operation; selected work avoids broad catalog.

machines.name: Artifact governance and semantic revision
machines.explicitness: explicit draft/approved with derived authority validity; ready/superseded admitted by schema without public transition writers
machines.state_storage: governance.state, approval history, current normative identity

transitions.guard: Ready + current exact approval receipt; plan bound approved_source to approved spec; allowed authority profile
transitions.effects: Append approval, increment revision, render and journal artifact.
transitions.failure_retry: Generic approve refuses sprint_pair/SMARTS profiles; invalid/stale receipt never changes state.

transitions.guard: valid closed changes alter normative hash
transitions.effects: Keep historical approvals; revision advances; surviving execution progress preserved.
transitions.failure_retry: CAS and structural errors refuse whole batch.

transitions.guard: valid bounded logo/name
transitions.effects: Increment model revision/hash only; normative identity unchanged.
transitions.failure_retry: No approval or receipt fabricated.

transitions.event: approval chain unavailable or subject changes
transitions.guard: on authority inspection
transitions.effects: Expose derived authority status without rewriting stored progress.
transitions.failure_retry: Strict authority consumers reject; ordinary progress can remain available.

machines.name: Stable symbol lifecycle
machines.explicitness: explicit retirement records; allocation history implicit in stable IDs
machines.state_storage: symbol index; normative records; retired_symbols

transitions.guard: valid collection; ID never active/retired/allocated in same batch
transitions.effects: Add stable record; sync execution for new tasks/prerequisites; increment revision.
transitions.failure_retry: ID reuse rejected; whole batch atomic.

transitions.guard: same immutable ID/kind; exact permitted fields or permutation
transitions.effects: Change fields/order; semantic validation then one journaled artifact save.
transitions.failure_retry: Kind/ID edits, dangling references or invalid reorder refuse.

transitions.guard: reason supplied; references remain valid; no conflicting orphan execution state
transitions.effects: Remove live record; append immutable tombstone with retiring revision/replacement.
transitions.failure_retry: Missing reason, tombstone editing, invalid replacement or dangling links refuse. Retiring tasks with check history currently fails due to N-F10.

transitions.guard: any attempt
transitions.effects: Reject resurrection or rewriting historical identity.
transitions.failure_retry: New logical record must use new ID.

machines.name: Readiness, open decisions and criterion coverage
machines.explicitness: explicit nested statuses; readiness derived, not stored authorization
machines.state_storage: normative open_decisions, criteria, dispositions; derived validation

transitions.guard: nonblank resolution; valid references
transitions.effects: Update normative record; formerly blocking readiness may clear.
transitions.failure_retry: Resolved without resolution is structurally invalid.

transitions.guard: valid closed schema
transitions.effects: Retain explicit unresolved state; blocking decision causes Ready failure.
transitions.failure_retry: No specialized irreversible transition policy: generic apply permits reopening. Deferred is a criterion disposition or decomposition question state, not a spec open-decision status.

transitions.guard: all required semantic fields; named tests for test commands; DAG/partition/input coverage; spec criterion mapping
transitions.effects: Return deterministic diagnostics; does not approve.
transitions.failure_retry: OPEN_BLOCKER, uncovered criterion/scope/input, invalid command etc remain diagnostic.

transitions.guard: Ready/Binding checks
transitions.effects: Refuse active not-applicable criterion or mandatory criterion disposition.
transitions.failure_retry: Must explicitly revise/retire outcome with reason; no automatic task execution.

machines.name: Plan–spec binding currency
machines.explicitness: implicit control state over files and guards
machines.state_storage: plan.normative.spec_ref and source normative hash

transitions.guard: same-slug Ready pair; exact spec_expected CAS when explicit draft mode
transitions.effects: Bind current spec digest; preserve execution/history; plan governance remains/resets draft, revision advances.
transitions.failure_retry: Concurrent source change or invalid pair refuses; no source approval invented.

transitions.guard: valid current spec; actual authority assessed
transitions.effects: Choose approved_source only when genuine source approval valid; preserve work state.
transitions.failure_retry: No approval receipt required just to rebind ordinary plan.

transitions.guard: later read or strict consume
transitions.effects: Advisory consumers report binding_current=false; strict Ready/authority consumers reject.
transitions.failure_retry: Task-start and ordinary reporting do not silently rebind or auto-clear stop.

machines.name: Ordinary task progress
machines.explicitness: explicit enum; branch chosen implicitly by presence of receipt fields
machines.state_storage: plan.execution.tasks[id].state, reason, historical evidence refs

transitions.guard: task live; CAS; no receipt/context-ticket/approval required
transitions.effects: Record implementation start; no source snapshot or verification evidence.
transitions.failure_retry: Any nonPENDING source returns NOT_PENDING, preserving blocked/active state.

transitions.guard: valid ordinary report
transitions.effects: Record implementation ready for review, evidence refs unchanged.
transitions.failure_retry: Other source states refuse; partial evidence fields never downgrade to ordinary path.

transitions.guard: explicit reason; target PENDING/REVIEW/BLOCKED
transitions.effects: Record correction/resume with reason, retain evidence; ordinary reconcile does not call invalidateDependents.
transitions.failure_retry: No proof or approval claim; protocol rejects other targets.

transitions.guard: reason present
transitions.effects: Record stop; mark transitive dependents STALE except already PENDING/BLOCKED; preserve receipts.
transitions.failure_retry: Does not automatically restart or clear another blocked task.

transitions.guard: nonempty live checkpoint; reason
transitions.effects: Record implementation done without claiming tests or review passed; schema 0.3.2.
transitions.failure_retry: PENDING/BLOCKED/STALE member refuses complete scope.

machines.name: Strict receipted task review, reconciliation and acceptance
machines.explicitness: explicit compatibility path; stricter behavior selected by supplied evidence
machines.state_storage: task state/evidence refs; scope baselines; current full input identity

transitions.guard: Ready approved plan+spec, approved_source binding, strict prereqs, current snapshot, both exact receipts, completion rules
transitions.effects: Append both refs, set/retain exact completion receipt selection; establish scope baseline if absent.
transitions.failure_retry: Stale plan baseline needs scope-reconcile; failed/missing named tests/stale refs reject.

transitions.guard: current reconciliation receipt exact input/task/target; REVIEW additionally TaskFresh
transitions.effects: Append evidence/reason; target other than REVIEW transitively invalidates dependents.
transitions.failure_retry: Invalid receipt/input/claim rejects all changes.

transitions.guard: current exact reconciliation receipt for scope/input
transitions.effects: Set base input and plan hashes; append reconciliation to member tasks.
transitions.failure_retry: Preserve prior evidence; cannot silently convert stale baseline.

transitions.guard: previous checkpoint accepted fresh; every member TaskFresh; exact current quality/completion evidence
transitions.effects: Accept entire scope atomically, append quality receipt.
transitions.failure_retry: Any failed member or prior scope refuses entire transition.

transitions.guard: strict guards+prereqs+snapshot
transitions.effects: Project all_accepted_and_current only when every task ACCEPTED, fresh, no conflicting checks or unassessed trimmed history.
transitions.failure_retry: May fail due to approval, stale source, infrastructure or missing evidence; never treats DONE/REVIEW as verification.

machines.name: Dependency invalidation and advisory scheduling
machines.explicitness: implicit control state over files and guards
machines.state_storage: task DAG, execution states, scoped prerequisites; derived advice

transitions.guard: all transitive dependencies REVIEW/DONE/ACCEPTED; scoped prereqs satisfied
transitions.effects: List candidate and first next_task; binding currency and prerequisites reported separately.
transitions.failure_retry: Unknown/missing dependencies explicit; no authority granted.

transitions.guard: transitive graph assessment
transitions.effects: Report exact blockers; unscoped legacy prereqs reported without inventing global scope.
transitions.failure_retry: Unrelated tasks can remain eligible.

transitions.event: task-block or strict reconcile nonREVIEW on ancestor
transitions.guard: transitive reachability
transitions.effects: Change progress label and reason, retain historical refs.
transitions.failure_retry: Plain ordinary reconcile differs: does not propagate this invalidation.

transitions.guard: later query
transitions.effects: No persisted scheduling ticket or worker dispatch; task-start checks duplicate start separately.
transitions.failure_retry: Advice can become stale before action; CAS protects mutation, not user intent.

machines.name: Prerequisite observation versus historical certification
machines.explicitness: explicit observation enum plus parallel historical enum
machines.state_storage: prerequisite_observations plus separate prerequisites/prerequisite_evidence maps

transitions.guard: definition kind fact/decision; source+summary; valid outcome; decision resolution requires user_statement
transitions.effects: Record caller_reported origin,time,definition digest; legacy flag/evidence not overwritten.
transitions.failure_retry: Agent/tool may record unknown decision; cannot assert resolved decision as agent/tool.

transitions.guard: current definition digest differs
transitions.effects: Expose stale observation as unknown, retain original.
transitions.failure_retry: No automatic recertification.

transitions.guard: historical receipt not live assessed here
transitions.effects: Report recorded legacy flag separately.
transitions.failure_retry: Never silently promote old satisfied flag into fresh observed fact.

transitions.guard: strict guards+snapshot; exact current prerequisite receipt
transitions.effects: Delete ordinary observation for ID, set legacy satisfied and append receipt.
transitions.failure_retry: Strict consumers require legacy receipts and reject presence of ordinary observation.

machines.name: Caller reported check history and applicability
machines.explicitness: implicit control state over files and guards
machines.state_storage: last 16 task_check_observations; task/criteria/source digests; journal history

transitions.guard: source+summary; exact declared argv/cwd/index if bound; pass exit matches; skip/unknown no exit
transitions.effects: Append inert caller_reported result, operation identity/time, task+criterion subject, bounded scoped source fingerprint if obtainable.
transitions.failure_retry: No test executes; no verification receipt or state approval.

transitions.guard: valid report
transitions.effects: Drop oldest current record; prior history remains journal before-image.
transitions.failure_retry: Trimmed history disclosed, not silently treated as full history.

transitions.guard: current task verification/path/criteria/constraint identity and partial input digest
transitions.effects: Report exact scope and uncertainty; no task state rewrite.
transitions.failure_retry: Unsafe/missing/too-large scoped reads downgrade to unassessed rather than blocking ordinary report.

transitions.guard: old full spec-binding semantics
transitions.to: current only if old exact subject still matches
transitions.effects: Keep historical broader invalidation scope.
transitions.failure_retry: No retroactive narrower authority.

machines.name: Check-conflict reconciliation
machines.explicitness: implicit control state over files and guards
machines.state_storage: derived from command-index matches, scoped source, retained report order/boundary

transitions.event: applicable declared fail or exact argv/cwd unindexed fail
transitions.guard: definition current; scoped input not known changed
transitions.effects: Retain conflict for every matching declared command.
transitions.failure_retry: Unindexed failure can match multiple identical commands; no index invented.

transitions.guard: same command; applicable; source scoped_unchanged
transitions.effects: Clear only matching earlier failed command.
transitions.failure_retry: Ad-hoc pass, skip, unknown or unassessed success does not clear failure.

transitions.guard: definition false or scoped_changed
transitions.effects: Exclude from current conflict and disclose ignored count.
transitions.failure_retry: Unassessed failure retained; no assumption it is obsolete.

transitions.guard: history no longer complete
transitions.effects: Surface unassessed history to explicit verification consumers.
transitions.failure_retry: Strict all-accepted cannot claim current verification from unknown lost history.

transitions.guard: receipt validated and captures exact report hashes
transitions.effects: Supersede only captured prior report identities.
transitions.failure_retry: Later otherwise identical report has distinct recording_operation_id and remains visible.

machines.name: Immutable observation, source, event and receipt chain
machines.explicitness: explicit versioned objects; validity and interrupted publication inferred
machines.state_storage: content-addressed evidence-contexts/observations/authority-sources/events/receipts

transitions.guard: exact selected subject + inputs; activity-specific guards
transitions.effects: Create immutable context describing exact subject/prompt/review material; no progress change.
transitions.failure_retry: Stale or mismatched subject rejects.

transitions.guard: closed producer profile, exact context/source/subject/version/identity correspondence
transitions.effects: Store immutable event then receipt; no automatic approval/task acceptance.
transitions.failure_retry: Interrupted between writes can retry same content hashes; legacy raw capture cannot mint current authority.

transitions.guard: all retained hashes/schemas/chains valid
transitions.effects: Read historical v0.1 evidence without relabeling current.
transitions.failure_retry: Missing/tampered chain rejects inspection.

transitions.guard: current formats/profile/subject correspond exactly
transitions.effects: Validate actual evidence links, not actor text/comments.
transitions.failure_retry: Historical authority rejected; actual host/user permission remains separate.

machines.name: Verification-input snapshot and output recognition
machines.explicitness: implicit control state over files and guards
machines.state_storage: derived manifest; git ship-set membership; normalized spec/plan hashes; reserved output registry

transitions.guard: safe roots/input policy; all internal output directories/objects recognized; no pending tx
transitions.effects: Inventory tracked present + nonignored untracked files or nonGit filesystem; hash bytes, dirs, modes, normative artifacts; fixed read-only Git probes.
transitions.failure_retry: Unsupported Git, unreadable membership, corrupt evidence, invalid reserved output fail; no fallback to partial manifest.

transitions.guard: same manifest digest
transitions.effects: Return input hash + metadata; exclude progress/presentation only after validating canonical HTML, known outputs, gate-events log.
transitions.failure_retry: Different digest ->CONCURRENT_CHANGE; does not protect against hostile ABA edits.

transitions.guard: new collection
transitions.effects: Evidence consumers compare exact subject identity; no automatic execution-state rewrite.
transitions.failure_retry: Ignored files and correctly recognized outputs excluded by declared contract.

transitions.guard: context-previews directory exists
transitions.effects: internalOutputsWith rejects directory as UNRECOGNIZED_OUTPUT despite PutDerived supporting it.
transitions.failure_retry: Confirmed source cross-machine defect; preserve output validation while registering correct inert-preview contract.

machines.name: Completion review selection and workspace closure
machines.explicitness: implicit control state over files and guards
machines.state_storage: completion_sha256 + selected receipt; immutable completion packet, mapped worktree identities and materials

transitions.guard: exact one qualified verification per task; mapped workspace and command executable/launch files current; materials bounded
transitions.effects: Freeze exact verifier chain, normalized consumer workspace, support file bytes/hash.
transitions.failure_retry: Missing/duplicate/foreign receipt, wrong profile, changed closure or unsafe files reject.

transitions.guard: packet digest + chain + current normalized closure and exact material bytes
transitions.effects: Revalidate; task stores completion_review_receipt and completion_sha256.
transitions.failure_retry: WORKSPACE_DRIFT / STALE_EVIDENCE if actual subject changes.

transitions.guard: same normalized consumer closure, current qualified run
transitions.effects: Permit new run identity without automatically invalidating review of unchanged subject.
transitions.failure_retry: Changed code/requirements/workspace/materials require actual reassessment, not just receipt churn.

transitions.guard: every scope task has current retained completion; all support material retained; exact or equivalent closure
transitions.effects: Aggregate exact task completed subjects for actual quality review.
transitions.failure_retry: Definition-only scope receipt or omitted prior material refuses downgrade.

transitions.guard: selected identity no longer matches or no retained link
transitions.effects: Keep explicit completion contract; no silent fallback to weaker historical path.
transitions.failure_retry: COMPLETION_REQUIRED.

machines.name: Atomic initial sprint pair approval
machines.explicitness: implicit control state over files and guards
machines.state_storage: same-slug spec+plan; immutable pair contract/contexts; approval refs

transitions.guard: both draft/no approvals; all tasks PENDING with no evidence/baselines; same slug
transitions.effects: Create paired subject contexts tied to one prompt, optional delegated-method scope.
transitions.failure_retry: Noninitial or already worked pair ->INITIAL_APPROVAL_ONLY.

transitions.guard: both observed sources exact same user reply/pair; exact spec+plan CAS
transitions.effects: Mint/load exact pair receipts, atomic two-artifact commit; plan approved_source binding.
transitions.failure_retry: No partial pair approval via generic approve; journal recovery handles interrupted replacement.

machines.name: Delegated SMARTS method change and reset closure
machines.explicitness: implicit control state over files and guards
machines.state_storage: method-scope hash; initial pair grant; workflow evidence; task/checkpoint DAG

transitions.guard: current exact grant/source; selected option changes only authorized task method; protected outcome scope unchanged
transitions.effects: Create workflow evidence and new approval; update method; expand reset closure to checkpoint siblings and transitive dependencies.
transitions.failure_retry: No actual method difference refuses; out-of-scope change refuses.

transitions.guard: no affected IN_PROGRESS task
transitions.effects: Clear affected scope baselines; preserve blocked stops and evidence refs.
transitions.failure_retry: ACTIVE_WORK rejects whole method mutation if any affected work active.

machines.name: Bounded retrieval, continuation and completed-delivery ticket
machines.explicitness: explicit token purpose; completion is delivery only
machines.state_storage: content-addressed context tokens or caller offsets+identity

transitions.guard: whole record fits budget; exact selection/vector/manifest/budget for continuation
transitions.effects: Return whole records; persist page token or context ticket in infrastructure.
transitions.failure_retry: Invalid cursor/oversize refuses; not a side-effect-free read.

transitions.guard: vector/manifest mismatch on resume
transitions.effects: Refuse continuation under old identity.
transitions.failure_retry: Restart coherent read; ticket grants no permission or comprehension.

transitions.guard: selected IDs and current model/full identity as required; valid offset; bounded whole items
transitions.effects: Return no ticket and context_complete=false; continuation identity prevents mixed artifact versions.
transitions.failure_retry: Invalid/stale selection or a single oversized record refuses, never returns nonadvancing page.

transitions.guard: exact current context selection and full delivery offset
transitions.effects: Validate retained ticket only.
transitions.failure_retry: No production call sites currently consume CheckTicket; ordinary task-start ignores historical ticket.

machines.name: Context ownership, inert preview and ordinary apply
machines.explicitness: implicit control state over files and guards
machines.state_storage: canonical Markdown + provenance; context-previews; operation journal

transitions.guard: document+provenance absent; typed selections/source evidence valid
transitions.effects: Retain exact before-images, proposed bytes/provenance and binding; canonical document still absent.
transitions.failure_retry: Preview may create infrastructure only; no authority.

transitions.guard: explicit selected ownership; before document exact; preserve controls
transitions.effects: Retain proposal that can acquire v2 ownership without forcing unrelated human text changes.
transitions.failure_retry: Existing v2 ownership cannot be adopted over as legacy.

transitions.guard: exact existing ownership; explicit selected anchors/fields; untouched provenance preserved
transitions.effects: Prepare selected change and accurate provenance; actual no-op rejects except meaningful ownership/provenance changes.
transitions.failure_retry: Ambiguous anchor, hidden activation/initialization change, forged ownership or source drift refuse.

transitions.guard: exact preview ref/hash/content; retained binding; source evidence and preimages still current
transitions.effects: Atomic document+provenance transaction under retained original operation ID; no approval needed.
transitions.failure_retry: REVISION_CONFLICT/SOURCE_EVIDENCE_CONFLICT reject stale proposal.

transitions.guard: same transaction binding
transitions.effects: Replay original result even if later source bytes changed.
transitions.failure_retry: Prepared journal requires recover; rolledback ID cannot resurrect.

transitions.from_state: preview retained with legacy authority context
transitions.from: preview retained with legacy authority context
transitions.guard: exact current host-user observation/receipt and preview binding
transitions.effects: Retain compatibility receipt verification then same ordinary mutation kernel.
transitions.failure_retry: Mixed receipt + ordinary-preview request rejects.

machines.name: Context initialization finalization
machines.explicitness: implicit control state over files and guards
machines.state_storage: CONTEXT activation/stage and INITIALIZED marker; 13 exact output hashes

transitions.effects: Retain exact finalization binding and marker insertion preview; no approval claim.
transitions.failure_retry: Missing/changed output, invalid questions/audit/activation refuse.

machines.name: Knowledge HTML ownership and migration cutover

machines.state_storage: CONTEXT artifact_format pointer, typed knowledge docs, native project identity, old sources/history

transitions.from: legacy Markdown owner with HTML docs prepared

machines.name: Knowledge three-way merge

machines.name: Knowledge/decomposition claim, question, run and promotion states

transitions.guard: source-observed requires source_refs; valid record

findings.title: Ordinary context previews poison strict snapshot output recognition
findings.detail: contextOrdinaryPreview calls PutDerived("context-previews"), but internalOutputsWith does not allow that reserved directory. Any successful preview therefore creates a directory that a subsequent strict Snapshot refuses as UNRECOGNIZED_OUTPUT. Completion normalized workspace scanning shares the same recognizer. Ordinary progress can still work; strict verification, review/quality/farm consumers can fail.
findings.recommendation: Add a closed validated context-preview output contract and exercise preview→snapshot→completion composition. Do not broadly ignore arbitrary .artifacts contents.

findings.title: Implemented repair-apply absent from capability operation list
findings.detail: protocol RequestSchema and JournaledMutation and Run support repair-apply; operations list returned by Names excludes it. Agent capability discovery cannot enumerate this implemented event.
findings.recommendation: Derive operation names, request dispatch coverage, side-effect class and lock policy from one repository-owned typed registry, with exhaustive coverage checks.

findings.status: source-confirmed semantics; intent requires product decision
findings.title: Ordinary reconciliation and blocking propagate different task-state invalidation
findings.detail: task-block calls invalidateDependents and writes STALE to every transitive dependent except PENDING/BLOCKED. Receipt-free task-reconcile changes selected state without invalidating dependents; receipted nonREVIEW reconciliation does invalidate. Stored STALE conflates progress and evidence/dependency assessment, despite ADR-0043 stating those are separate.
findings.recommendation: Specify existing branches explicitly; keep stored compatibility states for now, add orthogonal dependency/evidence assessments. Change propagation only through a versioned deliberate semantic migration with blocked-stop tests.

findings.title: Two kinds of review completion share REVIEW and accept-scope dispatch
findings.detail: Ordinary task-review means implementation reported ready, strict task-review means exact verification+review chain consumed; both store REVIEW. Ordinary accept-scope records DONE while strict path records ACCEPTED. The difference depends on request fields and available evidence, so event names alone are insufficient.
findings.recommendation: Expose effect/claim semantics and allowed next events in operation metadata/structured context; preserve legacy wire names and receipts.

findings.title: Read-side effects depend on operation mode and platform
findings.detail: Contextual read writes content-addressed delivery tokens; exact read does not. Darwin shared nativeLock invokes lockFile which creates metadata if absent. Windows shared observations explicitly require existing metadata and never initialize; Linux locks repository directory. The initStore comment "Reads never initialize" is too broad for Darwin.
findings.recommendation: Represent read-only/metadata-writing/external-effect traits explicitly and state native platform differences precisely; do not infer mutation class from command name.

findings.title: Stored check-status vocabulary exceeds reachable public mutation behavior
findings.detail: Work schema and renderers permit/display unknown/passed/failed, but work create/adoption initialize unknown and all native implemented lifecycle updates leave check_status unchanged. This is schema capacity, not proof of an implemented passed/failed event.
findings.recommendation: Classify schema-only states as such in machine contract/capabilities; do not invent an event or migrate progress into proof.

findings.title: Task context does inspect scoped source for recorded checks
findings.detail: taskContext comment says it does not inspect source files. It calls assessTaskChecks, which invokes scopedInputDigest and reads bounded declared paths, shared inputs and known build manifests.
findings.recommendation: Correct the bounded-read claim; keep source-scope disclosure in context output and performance expectations.

findings.title: Unsupported-platform message still describes Windows/macOS as pending
findings.detail: fs_other.unsupported says repository operations require Linux and Windows/macOS promotion pending; supported Darwin/Windows build files enable NativeWrites with actual backends. This is stale diagnostic prose, not evidence those supported platforms are disabled.
findings.recommendation: Generate platform capability text from current backend declaration or restrict diagnostic to unsupported GOOS without making release claims.

findings.status: Producer output reproduced in Python; native rejection source-confirmed only
findings.title: Valid npm launch bindings exceed native completion consumer cap
findings.detail: commandBindingSchema accepts 37 launch files and validateQualifiedBinding accepts 32 workspace manifests. completionWorkspacesOnce rejects any launch_files length above32. Hooks agent exercised actual Python _bind_commands with real temporary Git/npm fixtures:31 workspace manifests produced33 launch files;32 produced34 on POSIX. Windows adapted npm source can produce37. Evidence stored in audit-work/probe_launch_binding_results.json; no native Go test executed.
findings.recommendation: Use one role-aware binding bound across producer, schema and consumer; add boundary fixtures at32/33/37 with actual npm layouts without executing stored commands.

findings.title: Retirement with retained task checks or scope baselines is rejected as orphan state
findings.detail: syncExecution removes retired live task states but retains task_check_observations and existing scopes. Changes appends tombstones under retired_symbols. symbol.Build gives these tombstones Kind=retired_symbols; planStructure accepts historical checks for nonlive IDs only when Retired and Kind=tasks, impossible for the emitted tombstone. render.Prepare calls Structural, so task retirement after task-check fails ORPHAN_STATE. Removing a checkpoint with retained scope baseline similarly yields ORPHAN_STATE because syncExecution does not retire/remove scope entries.
findings.recommendation: Define retired-state ownership explicitly: preserve original record kind or validate history against an explicit typed retirement record; archive/retire scope baselines consistently. Preserve original evidence and journal history; do not simply delete checks to make retirement pass.

adr_assessments.assessment: Direction supports explicit state/evidence separation and ordinary progress without permission ceremony. It does not prohibit a compile-time transition registry. Existing strict optional paths must not become the default again. Task-block/STale and SMARTS resets need explicit semantic review against this principle.

Keep small kind-neutral file/CAS/journal kernel and closed per-kind contracts. Do not interpret accepted architecture as proof of implementation or a requirement for one mega state machine. It explicitly permits splitting proven boundaries if generic machinery harms correctness.

Supports staged intent, explicit sync, uncertainty reconciliation, no remote rollback claim. Manual Project sync-now is an explicit approved exception to issue after_merge timing; do not mistakenly homogenize it. Mapped effects add their own frozen generation/timing guards.
Historical campaign scope exception is not a permanent ban on locking/CAS; current native engine already has both. Do not cite it to reject common race hardening now.

Database-free remains consistent. Literal "no schema layer", "file-based prose", and "no transactional guarantees beyond append-only files" are superseded by implemented typed schema, HTML and journaled multi-file transactions plus ADR-0037. Do not add a database merely to model states; update historical/active claim classification.

decision.recommendation: One closed repository-owned transition and effect contract per domain, generating capability/event discovery, diagnostics, state tables and invariants, while preserving the current file/CAS/journal kernel and independently owned local progress, evidence assessment, authority and external delivery state.
why: UX: consistent truthful next actions, visible waiting reasons, no repeated approval ceremony or assumed remote success.
DX: eliminate drifting operation/output registries and handwritten event/guard duplication; keep per-domain ownership and ordinary Go/Python tooling.
AX: machine-readable allowed events, state identities, effect class and retry/recovery rules; no inference from command names/status words.
preserve: Existing stable IDs, schema version semantics, artifact hashes, exact before-image history and operation-id replay.
Separate local complete from tests/review/merged/delivered; no generated proof from progress.
Existing permission boundaries, explicit user stops, current provider authorization; transitions are not permissions.
Unknown external outcomes must reconcile before repeat send; no general compensation claim.
Exact generation bindings, known manual Project sync-now exception, cooperative concurrency scope.
No broad rewrite, daemon, database, general policy DSL or external state library required.
First repair output-registry incompatibility and discovery drift; then characterization tests for crossed machine boundaries before moving implementation.
rollout: Snapshot actual wire/schema/effect behavior at this commit; classify legacy supported events and unreachable schema states.
Add declarative compile-time registry alongside current implementation; generate tables/capabilities and validate exhaustive handler coverage.
Add closed context-preview output validation and exact preview→snapshot/normalized-completion regression; enumerate all PutDerived producers versus recognizers.
Extract pure per-domain decision functions behind unchanged public protocol, with effects executed through existing transaction or staged-intent mechanisms.
Migrate semantic state separation only explicitly and versioned; retain old reads/history/replay; prove exact artifacts across supported native platforms before any released claim.
decision.limits: No finite audit or refactor can guarantee every future UX/DX/AX metric improves or nothing ever breaks. The defensible promise is specified compatibility invariants plus discriminating tests and rollback for each migrated boundary.

coverage.testing: Go executable unavailable in PATH and usual install paths; no native tests executed. Relevant test source was read, not counted as passing. Findings above are static source evidence.
coverage.exclusions: Parser loops, ordinary iteration counters, pure formatting, schema field types and test-only fault-injection positions are not separately counted as product state machines. Closed semantic statuses and read/cache/recovery lifecycles are counted. Support files not fully read are explicitly listed; this is not a claim to exhaustive lexical review of all core/artifacts files.
